cart_center_340b_status.description: Six-character Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number (CCN) of the hospital that is a chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy center, zero-padded text. Key of the table and of cart_centers.csv in the 2026-10-24 snapshot, which holds the hospital name, state and Medicare discharge count.

Result of matching the center's own CCN to hospital records in the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) 340B registry export of 2026-06-23: active = a parent record at this CCN is participating (a parent record is the registration of the hospital itself; its off-site clinics are registered as child sites under it); inactive = records exist at this CCN but no parent record is participating on that date, whether terminated or not yet started; not_registered = no hospital record carries this CCN.

How the center reaches the 340B drug discount program in the 2026-06-23 export: direct = participating parent record at its own CCN; sibling = no participating record at its own CCN, but a participating child site of another hospital in the same health system sits at or beside the center's address or names its transplant or cell-therapy clinic (found by manual search); pending_direct = a parent record at its own CCN that starts on 2026-07-01 and is not yet participating; outside = none of these.

HRSA hospital entity type of the evidence record: DSH = disproportionate share hospital, PED = children's hospital, RRC = rural referral center, CAN = free-standing cancer hospital, SCH = sole community hospital, CAH = critical access hospital. Only DSH, PED, RRC and CAN occur.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: route_340b is outside: there is no evidence record.

cart_center_340b_status.description: What the entity type allows in law for an outpatient CAR-T dose: A = DSH or PED, a 340B price is legally possible; B = CAN, RRC, SCH or CAH, types for which drugs with an orphan designation (every CAR-T product) are excluded from 340B pricing unless the manufacturer offers it voluntarily; C = outside 340B. It does not show that any CAR-T dose was bought at a 340B price, and it counts the two records that start on 2026-07-01 but not the two that end on that date (see scheduled_registry_change).
HRSA 340B ID of the registry record that supports route_340b: the center's own parent record for direct and pending_direct rows, the other hospital's child-site record for sibling rows.
Medicare provider number on the evidence record. It equals ccn for direct and pending_direct rows; for sibling rows it is another hospital's CCN, which is not one of the 173 centers.

Participating start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the evidence record: start of the current registration under the current entity type for direct rows, start of the child site for sibling rows, and the future start for pending_direct rows. It is not the hospital's first 340B date, because a new registration resets it.

For sibling rows only: 1 when the name of the other hospital's child site names a bone marrow transplant or cell-therapy clinic, 0 when it is a general oncology, infusion or outpatient site at or next door to the center's address, which is weaker evidence.

Change to the center's own parent records that the 2026-06-23 export already holds for a later date, written as the date (YYYY-MM-DD), a colon and what starts or ends, for example "2026-07-01: DSH record ends; SCH record starts". Four centers have one, all dated 2026-07-01. class_340b applies the starts but not the endings.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: No such change. A future-dated record that ends on the day it starts is void and is not counted.

cart_center_340b_status.description: Every HRSA hospital entity type found on any record at the center's own CCN in the 2026-06-23 export, whether participating, terminated or future-dated, sorted and separated by |.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: No hospital record carries this CCN.

cart_center_340b_status.description: Number of registry records at the center's own CCN (parent and child sites) that are participating on 2026-06-23.
Number of registry records at the center's own CCN (parent and child sites) in the 2026-06-23 export, whether participating, terminated or future-dated.

1 when the CCN is one of the 11 cancer hospitals that CMS exempts from the Medicare inpatient prospective payment system (PPS), from the CMS list last modified 2026-03-17, else 0. Ten of the 11 are centers. They have no 2024 discharge count for Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Group (MS-DRG) 018, the inpatient payment group for CAR-T, in cart_centers.csv, and they were exempt from the 2018 to 2022 cut in Medicare payment for 340B drugs.

Evidence in words, written by hand for this project: for sibling and pending_direct rows the other hospital or record, the child-site name as the registry gives it and its start date; for outside rows why no route was found. BMT = bone marrow transplant; entity type codes as in entity_type_340b.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: route_340b is direct: the evidence record needs no note.

cart_center_340b_status.description: 1 when the CCN is a provider row in Addendum AAA of the CMS final rule on the remedy for 340B-acquired drug payment (CMS-1793-F, files dated 2023-10-27), else 0. Being listed does not mean a non-zero amount.

CMS estimate, in US dollars, of the payment the hospital did not receive (Medicare payment plus the beneficiary copayment share) for separately payable outpatient drugs bought under 340B on calendar-year 2018 claims, because they were paid at average sales price (ASP) minus 22.5% instead of ASP plus 6%; all drugs, no CAR-T breakout.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: The CCN is not a provider row of Addendum AAA (in_cms_340b_remedy_file = 0); 0.00 means listed with no affected payment that year.

cart_center_340b_status.description: CMS estimate, in US dollars, of the payment the hospital did not receive (Medicare payment plus the beneficiary copayment share) for separately payable outpatient drugs bought under 340B on calendar-year 2019 claims, because they were paid at average sales price (ASP) minus 22.5% instead of ASP plus 6%; all drugs, no CAR-T breakout.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: The CCN is not a provider row of Addendum AAA (in_cms_340b_remedy_file = 0); 0.00 means listed with no affected payment that year.

cart_center_340b_status.description: CMS estimate, in US dollars, of the payment the hospital did not receive (Medicare payment plus the beneficiary copayment share) for separately payable outpatient drugs bought under 340B on calendar-year 2020 claims, because they were paid at average sales price (ASP) minus 22.5% instead of ASP plus 6%; all drugs, no CAR-T breakout.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: The CCN is not a provider row of Addendum AAA (in_cms_340b_remedy_file = 0); 0.00 means listed with no affected payment that year.

cart_center_340b_status.description: CMS estimate, in US dollars, of the payment the hospital did not receive (Medicare payment plus the beneficiary copayment share) for separately payable outpatient drugs bought under 340B on calendar-year 2021 claims, because they were paid at average sales price (ASP) minus 22.5% instead of ASP plus 6%; all drugs, no CAR-T breakout.
cart_center_340b_status.missing_value: The CCN is not a provider row of Addendum AAA (in_cms_340b_remedy_file = 0); 0.00 means listed with no affected payment that year.

cart_product_orphan_designations.description: Brand name of the chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) product: Yescarta, Kymriah, Tecartus, Breyanzi, Abecma, Carvykti or Aucatzyl.

Indication for which the cited Food and Drug Administration (FDA) document states an orphan-drug designation, in short form: DLBCL = diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, PMBCL = primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, ALL = acute lymphoblastic leukemia, CLL/SLL = chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma, MCL = mantle cell lymphoma, 2L = second line, r/r = relapsed or refractory. A date in brackets is the approval date of a supplemental biologics license application (sBLA) whose letter states that the product has an orphan designation for that indication; one Breyanzi row groups three such supplements.
Date the orphan designation was granted as the FDA document states it: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the document gives only the month.
cart_product_orphan_designations.missing_value: The document confirms the designation without a date (designation_date_precision = not_stated).

cart_product_orphan_designations.description: How precisely the document dates the designation: day, month, or not_stated.

Short label of the FDA document or documents relied on, separated by "; ", with the date or year of the document where the compiled list recorded it. SBRA = summary basis for regulatory action; FL = follicular lymphoma.

Address on fda.gov of each document named in evidence_document, in the same order, separated by " | ". Two exceptions: the Carvykti row names a second document (the 2024 approval letter) whose address is not listed, and the Breyanzi row of three supplements lists its three letters.

Short extract copied word for word from one of the FDA documents at evidence_url that states the designation. On the Yescarta follicular lymphoma row the quote is from the approval letter and the date from the summary document.
Date of the collection run that assembled this table.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the clinician, ten digits. Every NPI of the 2026-10-24 universe table hcp_divisions.csv has one row per service year.
Calendar year in which the services were rendered, 2019 to 2024.

What the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) file Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Provider holds for the NPI in that year: published_split (a row with drug and non-drug payment), split_suppressed (a row with the total only, because one side rests on 1 to 10 beneficiaries), or no_row (no row, which happens with 10 or fewer beneficiaries or no claims as rendering provider).

Provider type on the CMS row for that year: the specialty reported on the NPI's claims and, when several were reported, the one with the most services that year. It is set per year and can change between years; it is a claims attribute, not a board certification.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row for the NPI in that year's file (by_provider_status = no_row); not zero.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: US dollars that Medicare fee-for-service Part B paid in the service year, after deductible and coinsurance, for all non-institutional services and drugs on which the NPI was the rendering provider. The money goes to the billing practice, not necessarily to the clinician.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row for the NPI in that year's file (by_provider_status = no_row); not zero.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: Part of total_medicare_payment_usd paid for billing codes on that year's Medicare Part B drug Average Sales Price (ASP) file. A 0 is published by CMS and means no beneficiary received such a drug from the NPI.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row that year, or the split is hidden by CMS; by_provider_status says which. Never zero. A hidden split with drug_suppression_indicator * means some drug billing, for 1 to 10 beneficiaries.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: Part of total_medicare_payment_usd paid for everything not on the ASP file: visits, drug administration, laboratory, imaging, and drugs billed under codes absent from that file. CMS calls this side medical services.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row that year, or the split is hidden by CMS; by_provider_status says which. Never zero.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: CMS code on the drug side: * = hidden because 1 to 10 beneficiaries received a drug on the ASP file from the NPI; # = hidden only so that the hidden non-drug side cannot be recomputed from the total.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: Drug side published, or no row that year; by_provider_status says which.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: CMS code on the non-drug side: * = hidden because 1 to 10 beneficiaries received non-drug services from the NPI; # = hidden only so that the hidden drug side cannot be recomputed from the total.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: Non-drug side published, or no row that year; by_provider_status says which.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries who received any Part B service from the NPI in the service year; at least 11 on every CMS row. A patient seen by several NPIs is counted once for each, so sums across NPIs are not patient counts.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row for the NPI in that year's file (by_provider_status = no_row); not zero.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: Beneficiaries who received a drug on the ASP file from the NPI in the service year; 0 or at least 11 when published.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row that year, or the split is hidden by CMS; by_provider_status says which. Never zero.

hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.description: Beneficiaries who received a service not on the ASP file from the NPI in the service year; at least 11 when published.
hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.missing_value: No row that year, or the split is hidden by CMS; by_provider_status says which. Never zero.

hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the clinician, ten digits; one row for every NPI of the 2026-10-24 universe table hcp_divisions.csv.
released_cells when at least one of the four sums on the row is filled, no_released_cells when all four are blank.

Why partb_drug_rows_medicare_payment_estimate_usd is filled or blank, read with the NPI's 2024 row of hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year: released_rows; no_released_rows (drug payment published above zero but every code cell is under 11 beneficiaries); drug_payment_zero (published zero); split_suppressed (drug payment hidden); no_by_provider_row. For the last three the blank follows from the release rule, since no code cell can then reach 11 beneficiaries; most of those NPIs were not queried for drug rows.

Estimated 2024 Medicare fee-for-service Part B payment in US dollars on the NPI's released drug rows: the sum of estimated_medicare_payment_usd over its rows in medicare_partb_drug_rows_2024. The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) releases an NPI x code x place-of-service cell only when it has 11 or more beneficiaries, so this is a floor under the NPI's 2024 drug_medicare_payment_usd in hcp_medicare_partb_payments_by_year.
hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.missing_value: No released drug row for the NPI; partb_drug_rows_status gives the reason. Not zero.

hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.description: Estimated 2024 Medicare fee-for-service Part B payment in US dollars on the NPI's released rows for 25 product codes used in lymphoma, in the non-facility setting (place_of_service O): the sum of estimated_medicare_payment_usd over its rows of medicare_partb_drug_rows_2024 with a lymphoma_product_family. Only rituximab, obinutuzumab and bendamustine codes have released rows, and all three are also used outside lymphoma.
hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.missing_value: No released row for any listed code; not zero and not evidence that the NPI does not treat lymphoma.

hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.description: Estimated 2024 Medicare payment in US dollars for chemotherapy infusion administration, codes 96413, 96415 and 96417, on the NPI's released non-facility rows of the CMS by-Provider-and-Service file: average Medicare payment times services, rounded to cents per row and summed.
hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.missing_value: No released row for any of the three codes (cell under 11 beneficiaries, or the administration is billed by a hospital or under another NPI); not zero.

hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.description: Sum of total_drug_cost_usd over the NPI's 2024 rows of part_d_lymphoma_orals_2024.csv (2026-10-24 snapshot; Medicare Part D prescriptions for seven oral agents). It is the gross cost of prescriptions filled at pharmacies, not a payment to the prescriber, and must not be added to the Part B columns.
hcp_medicare_service_product_features_20.missing_value: No published Part D row for any of the seven agents (CMS drops a prescriber x drug row with fewer than 11 claims); not zero.

medicare_partb_drug_rows_2024.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the rendering clinician, ten digits; always in the 2026-10-24 universe table hcp_divisions.csv.

Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) code of the drug as billed, code number only. Every row is a code that the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) flags as a drug on the Part B Average Sales Price file.
CMS place of service: O = non-facility (office or other non-facility setting), F = facility. Every row of this table is O.

This project's label when the code is one of 25 product codes used in lymphoma: rituximab_intravenous (originator and biosimilars), rituximab_subcutaneous, obinutuzumab or bendamustine on the rows present. None of these products is specific to lymphoma.
medicare_partb_drug_rows_2024.missing_value: The code is not on the project's list.

medicare_partb_drug_rows_2024.description: Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries who received the drug from the NPI in that place of service in 2024; at least 11, because CMS does not release smaller cells.
Billing units of the drug paid in 2024, as CMS counts services for the code. For a drug code this is a quantity of dosage units, not a number of administrations, and it can be fractional.
Average US dollars Medicare paid per unit after deductible and coinsurance, as CMS publishes it.
average_medicare_payment_usd times services_or_units, rounded to cents. It is an estimate of Medicare's payment on the row, since CMS publishes the average, not the sum.
data.cms.gov version identifier of the 2024 Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Provider and Service file.
